utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes, Bo, that's the spot I saw. Maybe we should add Mrs. Gable's house to the list as well.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great idea, Opal! I'll add Mrs. Gable's to the list. We can stop by her place later to see what she needs.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Perfect, Rosa. I'll keep an eye on her house until we swing by — make sure nothing else looks off.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I've heard a bit about the repair drive from Vik—what do you need help with?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, we need all hands on deck! You could help with fixing things, or just bring snacks and cheer everyone on—it'll be a great time, I promise!

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That sounds lovely! I'll bring my flickering lamp and maybe some cookies to share.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Do you know if there's a specific time we should show up, or can we come whenever?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Uli mentioned folks usually gather in the morning, but I think dropping by anytime is fine—they're pretty flexible.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Good to know. Should I bring my own safety gear, or is that provided too?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, the repair drive—right, that thing! I keep meaning to check my calendar. If you could give me a hand, I'd really appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: No problem, Oren! Let me check the neighborhood bulletin board—I think the schedule was posted there. I'll let you know as soon as I confirm the time.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh perfect, thanks Hana! I swear I'd lose my head if it wasn't screwed on. Let me know what time and I'll be there with my hammer—somewhere.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Noah, I'm glad you're here — we're plotting the repair drive stops and I was hoping to get your input on the best times to catch folks.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, the repair drive? I remember talking about it, but I've got no clue about the timing. What did we decide?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: We haven't locked anything in yet — I was thinking we'd start at Maple and Third after morning drop-off, say around 8:30? Does that work with your schedule?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yeah, it's a neighborhood repair drive. Bring your broken stuff and I'll take a look.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I'll bring what I have, but, uh, my tools might not be much.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey, don't worry about that—any tool is a good tool, and I've got plenty to share.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: So, when's the next repair drive? I've got that squeaky lawn mower ready to go.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Ira, the drive's set for this Saturday, but have you checked with Rey if the repair station's ready for lawn mowers?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Good thinking, Mina. I'll swing by Rey's place and ask about the lawn mower setup before Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Well Vik, I've got the repair drive planned for Saturday morning, starting at 9 sharp. I could use a hand keeping things on schedule.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Oh, the repair drive! We're meeting at the community center at 10 AM tomorrow to fix up the Smiths' fence. Don't forget your toolbox!

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Vik, I appreciate the enthusiasm, but there's been a change of plans—the drive is Saturday at 9, not tomorrow. Can you check the flyer on the board?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Tess, are you coming to the repair drive on Saturday? I'm bringing my tools to help out.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, absolutely! I'm dragging my old lawnmower out of the shed—it's been gathering dust for years. I can't wait to see if those volunteers can work their magic!

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: That's great, Tess! I'm sure the volunteers can fix it up. If you need a hand getting it over to the garage, just let me know.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I know it feels like a lot, but if we can get everyone to commit by Friday, we can map out pickup times and avoid any last-minute chaos.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Friday? And you're sure everyone's actually on board with this, not just nodding along to avoid an argument?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I get that, but if we don't set a firm deadline, we'll never get everyone to commit, and then we'll be scrambling.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Leo, sorry I'm late—did I miss anything for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Nope, still on for Saturday at 10am at my garage. Bring your broken stuff.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Good, glad I didn't miss much. I'll bring my toolbox and a couple of broken chairs.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Yes, the repair drive is this Saturday at the community center. We'll need folks to lend a hand fixing bikes and small appliances.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, right, the repair drive—sorry I keep spacing on the details. I'll try to dig up that old toaster if I can make it.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: No worries, Bo! A toaster sounds perfect — we'll have someone there who's great with small electronics.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Ira, I could use your help setting up the workstations Saturday morning. Can you meet me at the garage around 8?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Eli, I'll be there early too—need any help setting up before everyone arrives?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sure, Dane. If you could help tape down extension cords and organize the parts bins, that'd be a big help.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sure thing, Oren! I can meet up after school pickup today to sort out the schedule. How does 3 p.m. at the café sound?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh hey Faye, did I hear something about a café? Might swing by if I can—need a coffee break anyway.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Yeah, Bo, I'm meeting Oren to plan the repair drive schedule. You're welcome to join—more input is always good!

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Hey Gus, I'm organizing a repair drive this Saturday at 10am at my garage. Bring any broken electronics you want to fix.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Oh, that's perfect timing for the repair drive I was already planning! I'd be happy to help out with any tools or know-how.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great, sounds like we're on the same page. See you Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Rosa, I'm helping with the repair drive this Saturday. Want to join? We could use more hands.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That's wonderful, Sam! I've got a list of tasks right here — if you have a preference, I can slot you in where you'll shine best.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I'm happy to take on whatever's most needed, Rosa. I've got my tools ready, so just point me in the right direction.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Jules, flyers sound like a great plan—I'll grab the details off the bulletin board so we can get them printed this evening.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Rosa sure has a lot of energy for this drive. I'm still figuring out which tools I can spare.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Good point, Uli—let me see what Rosa has planned so we can match our tool donations. I'll swing by the bulletin board now to grab the schedule.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, so you're thinking of bringing your own tools, Cleo? That's great—every bit helps, and I'm sure the volunteers will appreciate it!

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yeah, I've got a few things set aside. Do you know what time we should start showing up on Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: We're kicking off at 9 a.m. sharp, but feel free to come a bit early to grab a good spot—I'll be there with coffee!

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So, should I start making a list of who's bringing what?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That’s a good start, but let’s first set a deadline for confirmations so we don’t end up scrambling for pickup slots.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Alright, what date do you think works best for the deadline?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Kira, I heard you're involved in the repair drive too—need any help rounding up broken appliances?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Yeah, I'm helping out, but are you sure we really need a whole drive for this? Seems like a lot of effort.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Well, sure, but think of it as a chance for neighbors to hang out and help each other—plus, I wouldn't mind getting that squeaky mower fixed.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Jules, don't forget the repair drive at the community center tomorrow at 10 AM! We're fixing up the Smiths' fence—bring your toolbox!

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Ah thanks for the heads-up, Vik! I've got my toolbox ready and already handed out a bunch of flyers at the dog park this morning.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: That's awesome, Jules! I'm bringing my old toaster too—though I think that's for a different event, but hey, the more fixing the better!

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, the repair drive? I think I heard something about that... remind me what it's for again?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: It's where we drop off broken appliances and electronics, and volunteers fix them up for free! I'm finally bringing my old lawnmower.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, that's brilliant! I've got a toaster that's been on the fritz—I'll bring it by.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hey Rey, I was just telling Noah about the repair drive this Saturday. We're fixing bikes and small appliances at the community center. Want to join?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yeah, I'd like that. I can bring my soldering iron and some wrenches.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great, Rey! A soldering iron will definitely come in handy—I saw a couple of lamps that need rewiring.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Hi Nell, I was just thinking about the repair drive. Do you have any specific addresses in mind where it should stop?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I haven't thought about addresses yet—I just heard about it from Vik and Rosa. I've got a flickering lamp I'd love to bring if they're fixing household items somewhere nearby.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Well, if you know the cross streets near your place, I can figure out if it's a good spot to add to the route. Faye suggested Maple and 3rd, so we're already thinking about high-traffic areas.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
